_readme: CAP-CATCH live calibration. SPEC: docs/research/20261106_CATCH_SPEC.md §5 (A1/A2/A3 are P0).
status MUST be CALIBRATED before seerauto.skills.catch.CatchPet will ever click. The shipped values are
placeholders copied from documented anchor points, NOT measurements: they are here so the schema is
concrete and the validator has types to check. A mismatch between reference.capture_px and the live
window makes the skill refuse (window geometry changes every session; AGENTS.md §5.5).
All *_px values are game_px = window-local DEVICE pixels of the current capture (2400x1600 on a 1200x800pt
Retina window). All *_roi_px are [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the same game_px space.
How to fill it: run tools/ctl.py look / hover (read-only) in a live battle, record A1/A2/A3, then edit this
file and set status=CALIBRATED + calibrated_at/by. Never guess a coordinate: leave it null and the skill
will refuse with the missing field named.

inventory.note: P1 (SPEC §5 B1): storage-box capsule icon + count. When null the session reports capsules_before=null and uses the configured upper budget.

pippi.note: SPEC §4: Lv1-2 wild 皮皮 on 克洛斯星 is the safest first target (no HP shaving needed).
